    local statements = entity.claims[propertyId]

    if propertyId and statements then
        local originalStatements = mw.clone(statements)

        for _, statement in ipairs(statements) do
            if qualOrRefUsageTrackingEnabled then
                statement["qualifiers"] = nil
                statement["references"] = nil
            end
        end

        local cloneOfStatements = mw.clone(statements)

        if qualOrRefUsageTrackingEnabled then
            for cloneKey, cloneOfStatement in ipairs(cloneOfStatements) do
                cloneOfStatement["qualifiers"] = originalStatements[cloneKey]["qualifiers"]
                cloneOfStatement["references"] = originalStatements[cloneKey]["references"]
            end
        end

        return cloneOfStatements
    end

    return statements
end

def get_section_size(text, section_name):
    """
    Returns the size of the specified section in characters, or -1 if not found.
    
    Args:
    text (str): The text containing the sections.
    section_name (str): The name of the section to find.
    
    Returns:
    int: Size of the section in characters, or -1 if not found.
    """
    start_index = text.find(f"[{section_name}]")
    if start_index == -1:
        return -1
    
    end_index = text.find("[/{}]".format(section_name), start_index)
    if end_index == -1:
        return -1
    
    section_text = text[start_index:end_index + len(section_name) + 2]
    return len(section_text)
